consequence.statement: Before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0, the StableConnectIdentities feature gate must be enabled and StrimziPodSets must be used when operating Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2.

original.statement: When upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older with Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands, the StableConnectIdentities feature gate must be enabled and StrimziPodSets must be used before upgrading to 0.46.0.

consequence.statement: Operators upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older with Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands must enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and make sure StrimziPodSets are used before upgrading to 0.46.0. The release notes do not say what fails if this step is skipped.
consequence.remediation: On the current (0.38 or older) operator, enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and make sure Connect and MirrorMaker 2 use StrimziPodSets, then upgrade to 0.46.0.

corrected.statement: Users of Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 from 0.38 or older must enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and use StrimziPodSets before the upgrade.

decision.reason: [ev-17b3774eb9ee] says that users running Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 who upgrade from Strimzi 0.38 or older must enable the `StableConnectIdentities` feature gate and use `StrimziPodSets` before upgrading. That is a required step before the upgrade, so migration-required is the right kind. The other "make sure … before upgrading" items in the same section, [ev-0fe6816db4bb] and [ev-4c2676e4665a], read the same way. The proposed statement leaves out the "from Strimzi 0.38 or older" qualifier, so it suggests that everyone using Connect or MirrorMaker 2 must do this. It also implies more than the evidence says, which does not state what fails if the step is skipped. The corrected statement fixes both points.
